skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain the concept of strategic human resource management, the role of human resources in strategy, and the relationship between human resource practices and business goals.
Understand and explain the process of developing human resource strategies, including planning, recruitment, performance management, training and development, compensation, and employee relations.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Evaluate Effectiveness of Human Resource Strategies
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Assess the effectiveness of individual components of human resource strategies and their contribution to overall business strategy.
Discuss and propose the development of appropriate human resource strategies that align with business strategy and objectives.
Demonstrate independent work skills and effective teamwork.
Demonstrate presentation skills, writing reports on issues related to strategic human resource management components.
Demonstrate skills in analyzing, synthesizing information, and solving problems related to specific organizational strategic human resource management content.
